summary.name: Free DNS (afraid.org)
summary.one_liner: Free DNS hosting service where members can host subdomains and manage DNS records for domains, including dynamic DNS, on a shared registry of public and private domains.
use_cases: Getting a free subdomain for a home server
Hosting DNS for a domain you own
Forwarding a web address to another URL
summary.what_it_does: The page is the domain registry listing of Free DNS (afraid.org), showing domains that members can create hosts on, with columns for owner, public or private status, and age. Each domain shows how many hosts are in use, for example mooo.com with about 874,000 hosts. Members can manage domains, subdomains, web forwards, dynamic DNS, IPv6 reverse records, and backup DNS from the member menu. The page also lists site statistics such as about 20,897 domains and 13.8 million records, and it mentions wildcard DNS and DNS auth trace tools. Premium membership is advertised at $5 a month.
notable: Large shared registry of about 20,897 domains that members can create hosts on
Dynamic DNS and static DNS services
Premium tier advertised at $5 a month
Listed in awesome-selfhosted under dynamic domain name services
caveats: Premium membership is paid ($5 a month on the page), while the base service is free
Hosts on other owners' domains are created with the domain owner's consent
Account recovery depends on the email address kept in preferences
